title: A status poll during a cold-window transcript read moves the stamp and returns a retryable 409
outcome: A status poll during a cold-window transcript read moves the stamp and returns a retryable 409
acceptance: A status poll of the same delegation that runs during a cold-window result read no longer makes that read return 409; a behavioural test interleaves the two without sleeps.
A change to the transcript itself during the read still fails revalidation as before.
